info.name: API Reference Associated Persons Health Insurance API

request.description: Returns group's health insurance `quote` for an `employer` by `employer_quote_id`.

query.description: Multiple values can be provided by separating them with a comma. Allowed values are: `pending_quote`, `action_required`, `not_undertaken`, `accepted`, `pending_insurer_acceptance`.
The page of results to return. Defaults to 1 if not provided.
The number of results to return per page. Defaults to 10 if not provided. Maximum value is 100.

request.description: Returns a list of health insurance `quotes` for an `employer`. The `quotes` are returned sorted by creation date, with the most recent `quote` appearing first.

response.name: OK
